name: The List
source:
"The List" follows our MC Rob, a young college student struggling to get by. His family is poor and they seem to not care about him after a strange event between his parents a few years back. Rob accepts the fact that his mother and father don’t really acknowledge him anymore and give all their love to his sister. The story picks up when Rob accepts an invitation to a poker game, where the events change his life forever.

[From [url=https://www.patreon.com/thelistsaga/about]Patreon[/url]]
translation:
《名单》讲述了我们的主持人罗布（Rob）的故事，他是一名挣扎求存的年轻大学生。他的家庭很穷，几年前他父母之间发生了一件奇怪的事情后，他们似乎不再关心他了。罗布接受了这样一个事实：他的父母不再真正承认他，而是把所有的爱都给了他的妹妹。故事从罗布接受扑克游戏邀请开始，其中发生的事件永远改变了他的生活。

[来自[url=https://www.patreon.com/thelistsaga/about]Patreon[/url]]
